from pathlib import Path
import collections, gzip, hashlib, json, statistics

P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(name):
    b = (P / name).read_bytes()
    return json.loads(gzip.decompress(b) if name.endswith('.gz') else b)
def stable(value): return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))
def bootstrap(values):
    state = 17112026
    def next_int():
        nonlocal state
        state ^= (state << 13) & 0xffffffff; state ^= state >> 17; state ^= (state << 5) & 0xffffffff; state &= 0xffffffff
        return state
    means = sorted(sum(values[next_int() % len(values)] for _ in values) / len(values) * 100 for _ in range(20000))
    return [means[500], means[19500]]

reg = read('registration.json'); reg_hash = hashlib.sha256((P / 'registration.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
families = []; counters = collections.Counter(); sources = {}; timings = collections.defaultdict(list)
for task in read('cases.json'):
    deltas = []; changes = 0; danger = 0; scores = collections.defaultdict(float)
    for seat in [0, 1]:
        for future in [0, 1]:
            case = f'{task["id"]}-s{seat}-f{future}'
            paths = {m:f'pilot/{case}-{m}.json.gz' for m in ['observe', 'candidate']}
            rows = {m:read(path) for m,path in paths.items()}
            assert read(f'pilot/complete-{case}.json')['qualityPassed']
            for mode,row in rows.items():
                assert row['qualityPassed'] and row['receipt']['qualityPassed']
                assert row['registrationSha256'] == reg_hash
                assert row['score'] in [0, 0.5, 1]
                assert row['result']['winner'] in ['green', 'red', 'draw']
                expected = 0.5 if row['result']['winner'] == 'draw' else int(row['result']['winner'] == ('green' if row['candidateTeam'] == 2 else 'red'))
                assert row['score'] == expected
                counters[f'{mode}_battles'] += 1
                counters[f'{mode}_wins' if row['score']==1 else f'{mode}_draws' if row['score']==0.5 else f'{mode}_losses'] += 1
                counters[f'{mode}_roots'] += len(row['observations'])
                counters[f'{mode}_danger_roots'] += sum(o['danger'] for o in row['observations'])
                counters[f'{mode}_overrides'] += sum(o['changed'] for o in row['observations'])
                timings[mode].append(row['elapsedMs'])
                sources[paths[mode]] = hashlib.sha256((P / paths[mode]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                scores[mode] += row['score']
            assert stable(rows['observe']['opening']) == stable(rows['candidate']['opening'])
            diff = rows['candidate']['score'] - rows['observe']['score']; deltas.append(diff)
            counters['better_cases' if diff > 0 else 'worse_cases' if diff < 0 else 'tied_cases'] += 1
            changed = stable(rows['candidate']['turns']) != stable(rows['observe']['turns'])
            changes += changed
            if changed: counters['changed_trajectories'] += 1
            else:
                for field in ['result','events','health']: assert stable(rows['candidate'][field]) == stable(rows['observe'][field])
            danger += sum(o['danger'] for o in rows['observe']['observations'])
    families.append({'id':task['id'],'map':task['map'],'d1':task['d1'],'d2':task['d2'],'pickOrder':task['pickOrder'],'delta':statistics.mean(deltas),'caseDeltas':deltas,'changedCases':changes,'baselineDangerRoots':danger,'scores':dict(scores)})
assert len(families) == 108 and counters['observe_battles'] == counters['candidate_battles'] == 432
values=[f['delta'] for f in families]; mean=statistics.mean(values)*100; interval=bootstrap(values)
groups={}
for axis in ['map','d1','d2','pickOrder']:
    groups[axis]={str(k):{'families':len([f for f in families if f[axis]==k]),'meanPp':statistics.mean(f['delta'] for f in families if f[axis]==k)*100} for k in sorted({f[axis] for f in families})}
changed_families=sum(f['changedCases'] > 0 for f in families)
gates={'meanAtLeastHalfPoint':mean>=0.5,'lower95StrictlyPositive':interval[0]>0,'atLeastTwelveChangedFamilies':changed_families>=12,'noMapOrDoctrineBelowMinusOnePoint':all(g['meanPp']>=-1 for axis in ['map','d1','d2'] for g in groups[axis].values())}
summary={'registrationSha256':reg_hash,'complete':True,'battles':864,'families':108,'meanScoreGainPp':mean,'familyBootstrap95Pp':interval,'counters':dict(counters),'changedFamilies':changed_families,'subgroups':groups,'gates':gates,'screenPassed':all(gates.values()),'promotionAuthorized':False,'wallTimeIsSharedLoadDescriptiveOnly':True,'medianBattleMs':{k:statistics.median(v) for k,v in timings.items()},'familyResults':families}
with(P/'analysis.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(summary,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
with(P/'result-receipts.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(sources,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in summary.items() if k not in ['familyResults','subgroups']}))

from pathlib import Path
import gzip,json,collections
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(n):
    b=(P/n).read_bytes();return json.loads(gzip.decompress(b) if n.endswith('.gz') else b)
cases=[];counts=collections.Counter()
for task in read('cases.json'):
    for seat in [0,1]:
        for future in [0,1]:
            case=f'{task["id"]}-s{seat}-f{future}'
            b=read(f'pilot/{case}-observe.json.gz');c=read(f'pilot/{case}-candidate.json.gz')
            assert b['qualityPassed'] and c['qualityPassed']
            changes=[o for o in c['observations'] if o['changed']]
            assert len(changes)<=1,(case,'correction budget exceeded')
            if not changes:
                assert c['turns']==b['turns'],(case,'unexplained change without a correction')
                assert c['events']==b['events'] and c['health']==b['health'] and c['result']==b['result']
                counts['unchangedCases']+=1;continue
            o=changes[0]
            first=next((i for i,(a,z) in enumerate(zip(b['turns'],c['turns'])) if a!=z),None)
            assert first is not None,(case,'correction not executed')
            old=b['turns'][first];new=c['turns'][first]
            assert old['unitId']==new['unitId']==o['actor']['id']
            assert old['chosenDecision']==o['chosen'] and new['chosenDecision']==o['finalChosen']
            assert b['turns'][:first]==c['turns'][:first]
            names={u['unitId']:u['creatureName'] for a in b['result']['placements'].values() for u in a}
            def targets(actions):return [names.get(a.get('targetId'),a.get('targetId')) for a in actions if a['type']=='range_attack']
            final=[s for s in o['scores'] if s['mode']=='turns'][-1]
            native=next(m for m,k in zip(final['means'],final['candidates']) if k['actions']==o['chosen'])
            delta=c['score']-b['score'];counts['better' if delta>0 else 'worse' if delta<0 else 'tiedChanged']+=1
            counts['correctedCases']+=1
            cases.append({'case':case,'family':task['id'],'map':task['map'],'ownDoctrine':task['d1'],'opponentDoctrine':task['d2'],
                'actor':o['actor']['name'],'actorHp':o['actor']['hp'],'lap':o['lap'],'nativeTargets':targets(o['chosen']),
                'correctedTargets':targets(o['finalChosen']),'nativeForecast':native,'correctedForecast':o['alternative']['mean'],
                'baselineScore':b['score'],'candidateScore':c['score'],'scoreDelta':delta,'prefixTurnsIdentical':first})
assert counts['unchangedCases']+counts['correctedCases']==432
result={'qualityPassed':True,'matchedCases':432,'allActionPrefixesVerified':True,'atMostOneCorrectionEveryBattle':True,
        'noUnexplainedTrajectoryChanges':True,'counts':dict(counts),'corrections':cases}
with(P/'causal-verification.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='corrections'}))

from pathlib import Path
import gzip,json
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
files=list((P/'cold').glob('*.json.gz'));assert len(files)==6
assert len(list((P/'cold').glob('complete-*.json')))==3
fields=['opening','result','turns','events','health','observations']
for file in files:
    c=json.loads(gzip.decompress(file.read_bytes()));b=json.loads(gzip.decompress((P/'pilot'/file.name).read_bytes()))
    for field in fields:assert c[field]==b[field],(file.name,field)
proof={'qualityPassed':True,'cases':3,'executions':6,'sourceHost':'hft','repeatHost':'local','fieldsIdentical':fields}
with(P/'cold-verification.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(proof,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(proof))

from pathlib import Path
import gzip, hashlib, json, re, sys, tarfile
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
expected=sys.argv[1];assert re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}',expected)
archive=P/'remote-results-final.tar.gz';assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
assert not (P/'pilot').exists()
with tarfile.open(archive)as t:t.extractall(P,filter='data')
files=list((P/'pilot').glob('*.json.gz'));assert len(files)==864
assert len(list((P/'pilot').glob('complete-*.json')))==432
registration=hashlib.sha256((P/'registration.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for file in files:
    raw=file.read_bytes();receipt=json.loads(Path(str(file)+'.receipt').read_text())
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==receipt['sha256'],file.name
    inflated=gzip.decompress(raw);assert hashlib.sha256(inflated).hexdigest()==receipt['rawSha256'],file.name
    row=json.loads(inflated);assert row['qualityPassed'] and row['receipt']['qualityPassed'] and row['registrationSha256']==registration
admitted=list((P/'admission-hft').glob('*.json'));assert len(admitted)==3
assert all(json.loads(f.read_text())['qualityPassed'] for f in admitted)
proof={'qualityPassed':True,'battles':864,'matchedCases':432,'allCompressedAndRawHashesValid':True,'allBattleQualityReceiptsPassed':True,'registrationSha256':registration,'archiveSha256':expected,'crossHostFunctionalCases':3}
with(P/'import-verification.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(proof,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(proof))
